`textstats` still prints `words:` and `lines:` from stdin. A sole `--top N`, where N matches `[1-9][0-9]*`, prints that summary and then the ranking: `<word> <frequency>`, highest frequency first, ties broken by ascending Unicode code point. For `A a A cat, cat cat,` and `--top 3`, stdout is:

```text
words: 6
lines: 1
A 2
cat, 2
a 1
```

A sole `--help` prints the new usage line on stdout and exits 0. Any other invocation prints that line on stderr and exits 2, without reading stdin.

`python3 -W error -m unittest tests.test_textstats -v` passed all 8 tests. `python3 -m py_compile` passed for `textstats.py` and `tests/test_textstats.py`. This repo has no typechecker configured.

`code-review` is pending. It reviews `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD`, and that range is empty while the work is uncommitted. Commit stays off, as you asked. The task branch is `main`, the same as its base branch, so a later archive will refuse it until the branch changes.
